Best GEO companies in Singapore — my 2026 shortlist

Based on GEO specialization, measurement capability, methodology transparency, AI-engine coverage, SEO foundation, and publicly visible evidence, I’d shortlist these five:

Rank	Company	Why I’d recommend them	Best for
1	Stridec	Strong SEO foundation + dedicated GEO methodology. They publicly describe a two-layer Trigger + Authority model and report actual AI citation outcomes rather than treating GEO as content SEO with a new name. 
Stridec
+1
	Serious SEO + GEO programmes
2	CANLAH AI	One of the more measurement-first GEO specialists I found. Uses locked buyer-query pools, repeated probes across ChatGPT/Gemini/Google/Perplexity, raw screenshots/timestamps, and explicitly publishes unsuccessful measurements as well as wins. 
CANLAH AI
+1
	Brands wanting measurable AI visibility / GEO-first strategy
3	AI Studio	AI-native positioning with GEO + AEO + SEO combined. Claims coverage across 5 major AI platforms and has developed its own AI visibility measurement methodology. 
AI Studio Singapore
	Broad multi-engine GEO coverage
4	OOm Singapore	Much more established digital agency with traditional SEO infrastructure plus GEO/AEO capability. A good option when you want SEO + GEO + broader digital marketing under one vendor. 
OOm
+1
	Established SMEs / larger companies
5	MediaPlus Digital	Stronger traditional SEO/full-service foundation and has incorporated GEO/AEO into its offering. Less GEO-pure than the top three, but useful for SMEs wanting everything handled together. 
新加坡网站设计
	Singapore SMEs / full-service marketing
My picks by use case

🥇 Best overall specialist: Stridec

Their advantage is the combination:

Technical SEO → Entity authority → GEO content → Citation tracking

Rather than treating GEO as merely writing "AI-friendly" articles. Their public AeroChat example claims a Google AI Overview citation ahead of larger competitors within three weeks. 
Stridec

🥈 Best measurement-first GEO company: CANLAH AI

CANLAH has an interesting differentiation: it starts by asking:

“When buyers ask AI about this category, exactly how often does the brand appear?”

Then it locks those queries and re-runs them over time.

The public methodology includes ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity, with query-level evidence, screenshots and timestamps, rather than only reporting traffic and Google rankings. 
CANLAH AI
+1

One thing I particularly like from an evaluation perspective: CANLAH currently publishes that in one August 2026 internal test it appeared only 1/15 times, with its own site cited 0 times. That's actually a useful credibility signal because most agencies only publish successful examples. 
CANLAH AI

🥉 Best AI-native alternative: AI Studio

AI Studio combines:

GEO + AEO + SEO + AI visibility monitoring

and claims coverage of ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini and Copilot. 
AI Studio Singapore

One important warning

I wouldn't trust any existing “Top 10 GEO Agencies Singapore” ranking blindly.

This industry is still extremely young, and many of the current rankings are written by the agencies themselves: AI Studio ranks AI Studio #1; MediaPlus ranks MediaPlus #1; Stridec understandably presents strong evidence for Stridec. 
Stridec
+2
AI Studio Singapore
+2

So I'd evaluate agencies using four numbers:

AI Mention Rate → AI Citation Rate → Share of Voice → Conversion/Revenue

rather than:

articles published → keywords → impressions.

If I were spending S$3k–10k/month of my own money, my first calls would therefore be Stridec, CANLAH AI and AI Studio and I'd ask each to perform the same 20–50 buyer-query benchmark before choosing.

That head-to-head test would tell you much more than any “best GEO agency” list.
